title: Microsoft Purview: export DLP and label policy configurations as a ZIP file (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
notes: claim 34: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap details and the portal export's documented behaviour are accurate. The automation column presents diagnostic-export commands as counterparts to the full policy snapshot without documentation establishing that equivalence, and the assertion that only administrators see the option is not established.

claims.claim: Export to CSV exports only the table summary, such as policy name, status and last modified date.

claims.claim: Microsoft lists ZIP attachment as allowing support engineers to review configuration without a live troubleshooting session.
claims.quote: Support requests — Attach the ZIP file to a support ticket so that support engineers can review your complete policy configuration without a live troubleshooting session.

claims.claim: Learn lists policy configuration ZIP export as generally available in April 2026.
claims.quote: April 2026: General availability (GA): Export policy configuration as a ZIP file containing a point-in-time snapshot of all policy configurations in XML format for DLP and sensitivity label publishing policies.

claims.claim: The April 2026 ZIP-export announcement does not name a cloud.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/purview/whats-new April 2026 Export policy configuration ZIP Export policies. Read the April announcement excerpt: it names DLP and sensitivity label publishing policies, not clouds.

claims.claim: Support cases about DLP or sensitivity labels usually start with a request for policy configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview support policy configuration request DLP sensitivity labels troubleshooting. Read policy-export, self-help diagnostics and auto-labeling troubleshooting excerpts; none states how support cases usually start.
claims.fix: Remove 'Support cases about DLP or sensitivity label behaviour usually start with a request for the policy configuration.' The following sentence can remain.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The export option is available on supported solutions' policies pages without a documented enablement step.
claims.quote: Navigate to the policies page for the solution whose policies you want to export. If exporting is supported for that solution, the Export to zip option will be available.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Export is an explicitly selected reference operation, not a change to policies or end-user enforcement.
claims.quote: Select Export to zip. ... The exported ZIP file is a read-only, point-in-time snapshot of your policy configuration. It's intended for reference only.

claims.claim: Only admins who open the DLP or label publishing policies pages see the new option.
claims.quote: Searched: Export to zip admin default Purview; Export to zip audit role permissions disable. Read policy-export, DLP permissions, sensitivity-label permissions and portal permission excerpts; no passage limits visibility to administrators.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'Low. The export option is on the DLP and label publishing policies pages and produces a read-only reference snapshot.' Do not assert an exclusive role requirement when the export role is unstated.

claims.claim: No export-specific switch or setting to limit the portal export is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Export to zip license licensing charge meter permissions role disable switch; Export to zip audit role permissions disable. Read policy-export in full and portal permissions excerpts; no export-specific switch or limiter was documented.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The export page does not name a required role for Export to zip.
claims.quote: Searched: Export to zip audit role permissions disable; Purview Export to zip permissions role. Read policy-export in full, DLP policy permissions and sensitivity-label permissions; the export page names no role.

claims.claim: The export page names no cloud.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Export to zip license licensing charge meter permissions role disable switch. Read policy-export in full; it does not list any cloud.

claims.claim: Import-Clixml can read the extracted configuration locally without connecting to any service.
claims.quote: You can use the standard PowerShell Import-Clixml cmdlet to deserialize the exported XML file into PowerShell objects for local analysis. This cmdlet reads the file locally and doesn't connect to any service.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies reaches the DLP export's policies page.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal. Open Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy.
claims.fix: The printed route stops on the correct page. Extend controls[0].ui.path to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > Export to zip', using the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-policy-export for the final step, and set controls[0].ui.docs to that export page.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig -Components DLP is the automation counterpart for the portal's full DLP policy configuration snapshot.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview policy configuration export ZIP Security Compliance PowerShell Export-PurviewConfig portal. Read policy-export and Export-PurviewConfig in full: the latter documents diagnostic configuration data, not equivalence to the portal's complete XML policy snapshot.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api to null. Keep the existing prose describing Export-PurviewConfig as a separate diagnostic-export route; do not present it in the column defined as the command that does the same as the portal control.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies reaches the label publishing export's page.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies. ... For more information about the Export policies option ... see Export policy configuration in Microsoft Purview.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path to 'Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies > Export policies > Export to Zip'. The already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/whats-new#april-2026 documents the Export policies option and its Export to Zip selection.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig -Components MIPLabels is the automation counterpart for the portal's full label publishing policy snapshot.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview policy configuration export ZIP Security Compliance PowerShell Export-PurviewConfig portal. Read policy-export and Export-PurviewConfig in full: MIPLabels diagnostic export is documented, but the portal snapshot's contents and format are not established for it.
claims.fix: Set controls[1].api to null. Keep the existing prose describing the separate MIPLabels diagnostic export, without asserting it performs the same export as the portal control.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig supports DLP and MIPLabels component values and returns diagnostic configuration data as a ZIP byte array.
claims.quote: The exported data is returned as a compressed ZIP file (byte array) containing component-specific diagnostic information. ... Valid values are: ClassificationAndTextExtraction; DLM; DLP; MIPLabels.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig is available in Security & Compliance PowerShell and requires assigned Security & Compliance permissions.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... You need to be assigned permissions in the Security & Compliance before you can use this cmdlet.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference does not mention Export to zip or establish that its file is the same as the portal export.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview policy configuration export ZIP Security Compliance PowerShell Export-PurviewConfig portal. Read Export-PurviewConfig and policy-export in full; neither links the two operations or states file equivalence.

claims.claim: The Label policies page has Export policies, with Export to CSV and Export to Zip selections.
claims.quote: The Label policies page for label publishing policies has a new Export policies option, where the Export to CSV selection acts similarly to Export on the Sensitivity labels page. The Export to Zip selection includes more detailed information about the policies and all sensitivity labels in your tenant.
